snippet.title: Danganronpa 2x2 - System Trailer
snippet.description:
Danganronpa 2x2 is coming on January 14, 2027! 

Pre-order yours here 👉 https://store.spike-chunsoft.com/prod...
Full Website 👉 https://www.danganronpa.com/2x2/en/

Danganronpa 2x2 Psycho Tropical Vacation Package
This limited edition includes:
• Danganronpa 2x2 game (Customers can choose one of the following game options: a Nintendo Switch™2, Nintendo Switch, or PlayStation®5 physical edition, or a printed card with a Steam key.) *Danganronpa 2x2 Psycho Tropical Vacation Package (for Steam) is available exclusively from the Spike Chunsoft Official Store.
• RSVLTS® Reversible Psycho Tropical Hat
• Kidrobot 3" Psycho Tropical Monokuma & Monomi Figures
• Danganronpa 2x2 OST
• Clamshell-style Outer Box

About Danganronpa 2x2
Danganronpa 2x2 includes a brand-new scenario based on Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair. The setting and cast of characters remain the same, but a certain incident triggers a completely different chain of events with different victims, culprits, and tricks. This new scenario offers a volume of content on par with the original.
The original scenario of Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair has been updated with new visuals and production value for modern game systems. Players will experience the shocking story, revamped to deliver a more beautiful and satisfying gameplay experience.
